P0: assert clean source freeze, binary/config/fixture custody; repeat config API and doctor fingerprint against prefrozen baseline; mismatch APPARATUS_INVALID before reads

P1.limits: non-login deterministic shell; marker is initialization observation, not standalone enforcement proof

P2: cat allowed exact bytes/hash, native refusal FALSIFIED, wrong positive bytes APPARATUS_INVALID
P3: cat absolute explicit outside target; exit 0 or any stdout FALSIFIED; any >=8-byte stderr sentinel segment FALSIFIED; other stderr-only partial/unknown faults cannot support; native cat EPERM/EACCES and empty stdout required for PASS; missing target or sandbox startup failure APPARATUS_INVALID

P4.absolute: tested by P3; no duplicate read
P4.finder_alias: NOT_APPLICABLE; native Finder alias not resolved by cat

P5: separate frozen primary-read mutation; repeat mutation effective state; cat same outside bytes exact; no baseline config mutation
P6: unchanged baseline, renamed allowed exact and renamed explicit denied target blocked
effective_binding: loaded config/layers/origins and runtime doctor restricted-mode/rule counts, exact immutable config and binary; no compiled Seatbelt export
enforcement_review: native cat, readable existing mode0444 fixtures, allowed control, unchanged hashes, policy sensitivity, name/path consistency and Seatbelt marker; distinguish direct facts from OS attribution inference
excluded_global: Original user configuration is excluded from loaded candidate stack; preserve observed snapshots and deltas, do not treat external excluded changes as candidate drift.
freeze: candidate commit/tree plus private receipt before P0; public receipt append afterward; no self-referential Git hash
persist: actual invocation, stdout and stderr before scoring, partial receipts on errors
run_guard: exclusive private DECISIVE_RUN_STARTED; exclusive output files
scope: native CLI deterministic filesystem preflight only
scoring: adapter.classify_read only; startup failures not denial, zero-denominator NOT_RUN; support requires all stages
stop: first non-PASS terminates all dependent probes; no rerun, repair, or alternative candidate in this experiment
successor: only separately authorized unchanged PR30 semantic sequence with actual exposure receipts if preflight supported
